name: Absalon Sprinckirsbacensis
modernTranslations: Sermons for the Liturgical Year (Brepols, selection of sermons in modern English)
untranslatedHighlights: Majority of works remain in Latin only
notes: Documenta Catholica Omnia shows Latin texts from PL only. WorldCat confirms modern English translation exists but access blocked.

name: Christianus Druthmarus
modernTranslations: none
untranslatedHighlights: Expositio in Matthaeum (Commentary on Matthew), biblical commentaries
notes: Only Latin texts available from Documenta Catholica/Migne PL. Carolingian exegete, no modern translation efforts located.

name: Joannes VIII
modernTranslations: Selected papal letters translated in Epistolae (Columbia University)
untranslatedHighlights: Papal register (Registrum), decretals largely untranslated in English
notes: Letters accessible in English at Epistolae; broader papal corpus in Latin only at Patrologia Latina.

name: Humbertus Silvae Candidae
modernTranslations: Summary of the Papal Embassy to Constantinople (W. L. North translation, Carleton College)
untranslatedHighlights: Libri tres adversus Simoniacos (main work), Diversorum patrum sententiae, Adversus Graecorum calumnias remain primarily in Latin
notes: One major work translated; other works referenced in scholarship but not comprehensively translated.

name: Garnerius Lingonensis
modernTranslations: none
untranslatedHighlights: Sermones in festa Domini et Sanctorum, Vita Operaque, Allegoriae sacrae scripturae
notes: Only Latin texts available. Studied by medievalists but no published English translation located.

name: Ennodius Ticinensis
modernTranslations: The Poetry of Ennodius (Mulligan, Routledge); The Life of Saint Epiphanius (Cook); Letters translation forthcoming
untranslatedHighlights: Some prose works remain in Latin only
notes: Significant modern translation coverage for major works; late antique author with strong contemporary scholarly interest.

name: Wolbero S. Pantaleonis
modernTranslations: none
untranslatedHighlights: Commentaria super Canticum Canticorum (Commentary on Song of Songs), chronicle materials
notes: Only Latin texts available; commentaries reprinted in 2025 from 1630 edition but no English translation.

name: Ernaldus Bonaevallis
modernTranslations: none
untranslatedHighlights: De ultimis verbis domini, De septem verbis Domini in cruce, other theological works
notes: Studied by scholars but no modern critical edition or English translation published.

name: Lucius III
modernTranslations: Letter against heretics (ad abolendam), select letters translated
untranslatedHighlights: Full papal register remains primarily in Latin (P.L. CCI, 1071-1376)
notes: Key letters available in English; complete corpus translation status unclear.

name: Gelasius I
modernTranslations: The Letters of Gelasius I (Neil & Allen, Brepols, bilingual ed.); Decretum Gelasianum; The See of Peter (online, comprehensive)
untranslatedHighlights: Minor fragments and less studied treatises may remain Latin-only
notes: Extensive modern translation coverage; well-studied patristic figure with multiple English editions.

name: Jonas Aurelianus
modernTranslations: Regula cuiusdam ad uirgines (monastic rule, Brepols Disciplina Monastica series, with English translation)
untranslatedHighlights: Other works remain primarily in Latin
notes: Key monastic rule translated; broader corpus not systematically translated.

name: Wilhelmus Hirsaugiensis
modernTranslations: none
untranslatedHighlights: Writings on music and astronomy, commentaries
notes: Benedictine abbot known for music/astronomy works; no English translations located.

name: Benedictus diaconus
modernTranslations: unknown
untranslatedHighlights: Works referenced in PL 89, specific corpus unclear
notes: Deacon figure in PL collection; insufficient information to establish translation status with certainty.

name: Constantinus I
pdTranslations: Edict of Milan (313); official letters via Eusebius
modernTranslations: Edict of Milan; official letters; speech to Church Council (translations primarily via Eusebius of Caesarea, Church Fathers collections)
untranslatedHighlights: Some official correspondence may remain Latin-only
notes: Major writings available in English via patristic sources; well-documented through Eusebius translations.

name: Urbanus II
modernTranslations: Papal letters to Bologna (1096), Clermont Council speech, select crusade-related letters (Edwards Peters, Hagenmeyer, scholarly editions)
untranslatedHighlights: Full papal register remains primarily untranslated
notes: Key letters translated; complete works in Latin (PL).

name: Taio Caesaraugustanus
modernTranslations: none
untranslatedHighlights: Sententiarum Libri V (main work), theological compilation of Gregory the Great extracts
notes: Visigothic-era bishop; works available in Latin from Migne and digital collections but no English translation located.

name: Aimoinus Floriacensis
modernTranslations: none
untranslatedHighlights: Historia Francorum, Vita Abbonis
notes: Medieval monk-chronicler; Latin texts available (Gallica BnF) but no modern English translation published.

name: Rufinus Aquileiensis
pdTranslations: Commentary on Apostles' Creed (via Church Fathers collection, New Advent)
modernTranslations: Church History Books 10-11 (Amidon, Oxford University Press 1997); Commentarius in symbolum apostolorum (New Advent); selections via scholarly translations
untranslatedHighlights: Some theological works remain Latin-only
notes: Late antique patristic figure; significant modern translation coverage of major works.

name: Walafridus Strabo
modernTranslations: Hortulus (Raef Payne translation, with Wilfrid Blunt commentary, Hunt Botanical Library 1966); modern editions via Goodreads/academic publishers
untranslatedHighlights: Glosa ordinaria and most theological/exegetical works remain Latin-only
notes: Carolingian monk; Hortulus is well-translated; Glosa ordinaria too specialized/technical for general translation.

name: Conradus Eberbacensis
modernTranslations: The Great Beginning of Citeaux: The Exordium Magnum of Conrad of Eberbach (Ward, Savage, Elder eds., Cistercian Fathers series No. 72, 2012)
untranslatedHighlights: Minor works may remain Latin-only; main opus translated
notes: Cistercian historian; major work Exordium Magnum comprehensively translated and published in scholarly series.
